title: polystichum lobatum
intro: Polystichum lobatum, commonly known as the Rattlesnake Brake or Eastern Lady Fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for various purposes. The health benefits of Polystichum lobatum include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce stress, improve respiratory health, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as diuretic, anti-diarrheal, and antispasmodic effects.
